newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan stocks end little changed, thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan stocks end little changed, thin trade.

text.p: Colombo stocks closed barely moved in thin trade which was dominated by retailers, with institutional investors on the sidelines due to a lack of shares, brokers said.
The all share index closed 0.49 points higher at 559.50.

"Foreign and local institutional investors are keen to buy selected stocks. But since they want at least 30,000 to 50,000 shares, there is a problem with finding quantity," said Dimantha Kohombanwickramage of NDBS Stock Brokers.
Brokers said they saw bids at five percent above last traded prices for some blue chips but sellers were holding out.
Ahungalla Hotels rose 1.50 rupees to 30 and Union Assurance one rupee to 37.
Turnover was a thin 9.06 million rupees on 656,048 shares, supported mainly by retail investors, brokers said.
Big retail investors were picking up small quantities of shares and taking short-term gains wherever possible, brokers said.
